intro: Daryn Lightwind hands over her book, Feralas: A History, and asks you to take care of it. It goes to Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold, who is surely eager for your return.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here it is, friend. Please, take care of my book.
Now, hurry along. I'm sure Troyas is eager for your return.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Have you been to Darnassus?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have brought a book along. Excellent!
